critical_code_review_comments: tests/conftest.py:_motor_loop_rebind is well-designed: (a) it's autouse but no-ops when core.db is not loaded, so HTTP-only suites (iter45/47/48) are completely unaffected; (b) it detects closed loops AND mismatched loops via the _io_loop heuristic; (c) it correctly propagates the fresh client/db to all cached modules listed in _MOTOR_REBIND_MODULES; (d) it intentionally skips teardown to avoid double-close. Verified empirically: cross-file suite went from 9 failed + 5 errors → 68 passed, 0 errors.
Use of _io_loop is a private motor API but is acknowledged in the comments and guarded by try/except — acceptable for a test-only fixture.

context_for_next_testing_agent: The motor/event-loop rebind fixture (tests/conftest.py:_motor_loop_rebind) is now the canonical mitigation for cross-file pytest flakes in this repo. When adding new test files that interact with core.db, no extra wiring is required — the fixture detects core.db usage automatically. NOTE: when running multiple suites back-to-back hitting /api/auth/login, expect occasional 429 from the rate limiter; add 60s cooldown or run suites individually. The public URL ingress does NOT route /.well-known/* to backend; iter47 tests skip those checks with INFRA_NOTE — do not flag this as a regression.
rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (resolved): Motor's AsyncIOMotorClient binds its internal _io_loop to the first asyncio event loop it observes at instantiation. When pytest runs multiple test files in a single process, each file may create/close its own event loop. Modules that did `from core.db import db` at import time held a reference to a client whose _io_loop pointed to an already-closed loop, triggering `RuntimeError: Event loop is closed` on any subsequent direct mongo call (iter46 TestMPOverflowRefund + TestStripeOverflowRefund — 5 ERRORs). REPRO: `pytest test_iter45 test_iter46 test_iter47 test_iter48` → 9 failed + 5 errors. MITIGATION (now in place): autouse fixture `_motor_loop_rebind` in tests/conftest.py: detects closed/mismatched loops, instantiates a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient bound to the active loop, and propagates the new client/db references to all cached modules (core.db, routers.mercadopago, routers.payments_router, core.helpers, core.concurrency, services.push_service). VERIFIED: combined run now 68 passed, 2 skipped, 0 errors, 0 failures.
